datasets.name: 22e32205
queryLines:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN age < 40 THEN '<40'
        WHEN age < 50 THEN '40–49'
        WHEN age < 60 THEN '50–59'
        WHEN age < 70 THEN '60–69'
        WHEN age < 80 THEN '70–79'
        ELSE '80+'
    END AS age_group,

    CASE
        WHEN age < 40 THEN 1
        WHEN age < 50 THEN 2
        WHEN age < 60 THEN 3
        WHEN age < 70 THEN 4
        WHEN age < 80 THEN 5
        ELSE 6
    END AS age_group_order,

    CASE
        WHEN stroke = 1 THEN 'Stroke'
        ELSE 'No stroke'
    END AS stroke,

    COUNT(*) AS patient_count

FROM workspace.stroke_prediction.stroke_clean

GROUP BY
    age_group,
    age_group_order,
    stroke

ORDER BY
    age_group_order,
    stroke

datasets.name: cbb96137
queryLines:
SELECT
    'Sex' AS risk_factor,
    gender AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    SUM(stroke) AS stroke_count,
    100.0 * AVG(stroke) AS stroke_prevalence
FROM workspace.stroke_prediction.stroke_clean
GROUP BY gender

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Hypertension' AS risk_factor,
    CASE
        WHEN hypertension = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    SUM(stroke) AS stroke_count,
    100.0 * AVG(stroke) AS stroke_prevalence
FROM workspace.stroke_prediction.stroke_clean
GROUP BY hypertension

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Heart disease' AS risk_factor,
    CASE
        WHEN heart_disease = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    SUM(stroke) AS stroke_count,
    100.0 * AVG(stroke) AS stroke_prevalence
FROM workspace.stroke_prediction.stroke_clean
GROUP BY heart_disease

queryLines:
